title: Interfaces pillar: the rail is the app's navigation tree (groups, metadata icons, kind tags), "+" offers the ten nav kinds, and the canvas follows the kind: page regions designer, object runtime list preview, dashboard canvas
body:
## Source

Epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446, decisions 1, 3 and 5. Measured on objectui main `a2225f91` at `/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/interfaces` against the running HotCRM app's sidebar and `src/sales/apps/crm.app.ts`: the shipped sidebar renders Home, Sales Home, then the groups Sales, My Work, Activity, Marketing, Service, Insights, each entry with its metadata icon (`home`, `layout-grid`, `user-plus`, `building`, `target`, `receipt`, `file-signature`, `package`, `chart-line`, `circle-check`, `calendar-days`, `inbox`, `activity`, `megaphone`, `layout-dashboard`, `trending-up`, `columns-3`). The spec declares ten nav kinds: object, page, dashboard, report, url, action, component, doc, group, separator. Studio's rail today shows a second band ("Home · Dashboard"), two-line rows with ids and no icons, "Canvas / Properties" as tabs with a `w-9` icon strip, and a Design / Run pair below.

The maintainer's ruling (quoted on the epic): look at the real frontend; there are many menu kinds, the dashboard is only one.

## Target

1. **Rail** (shared rail card): the navigation tree as the shipped sidebar orders it. Top-level entries and group headers (uppercase 11 px label with a chevron, collapsible, honoring the metadata `expanded` default); child rows indented 12 px; every row shows its metadata icon, its label, and a 10 px uppercase kind tag at the right — Dashboard, Page, Object, View (an object entry bound to `viewName`), Component, Report, Link, Action, Doc; separators render as 1 px rules; an empty group shows "No items in this package". The id and the bound target stay in the row's title. The "+" in the rail header opens a kind picker: a 268 px popover listing the ten kinds, each with its glyph, name and one-line description (Object — a list view or one record; Page — a custom page built from blocks; Dashboard — widgets over filters; Report — a saved report; Link — an external URL, same or new tab; Action — runs a global action from the menu; Component — a registered component, like the approvals inbox; Doc — a doc page, a book, or both; Group — a titled section of the menu; Separator — a divider, no label, opens nothing). Choosing one adds the unbound entry and opens its inspector (today's create flow for pages / dashboards / reports continues from there).
2. **Item header row**: a primary-soft tile with the kind's icon, the entry label at 18 px / 600, a kind chip, the target api name as a mono chip; at the right Design / Run as a 26 px segmented control (pencil and play glyphs; hidden for kinds that have no design mode, as today's `StudioCanvas` gate decides), a divider, the properties toggle (`aria-pressed`), a more button. The "Home · Dashboard" band retires.
3. **Tab row**: Canvas, and Source where the kind has a source editor (page, dashboard, report); object entries show Preview only with a trailing 12 px note "Runtime list preview · fields and structure are edited in the Data pillar" and an "Open in Data" outline chip in the header.
4. **Canvas by kind**: page — a sidebar-tinted designer whose regions (`header · full`, `left_sidebar · small`, `main · large`, `right_sidebar · medium`, named from the page's own layout) are dashed 8 px frames with a 10 px uppercase region label, blocks as white cards with a title, `#id` in mono and a kind tag (`page:card`, `page:tabs`, `list-view`, `object-metric`, `element:text`), an empty region reading "Empty region. Drop a block here.", a "Design mode · drop blocks into a region, click a block to edit it" toolbar with "Add block"; object — the runtime list in a white 8 px card (search, density, Export, New; the grid; a footer count); dashboard — today's widget canvas with the widget cards at 16 px padding and the selected widget ringed.
5. **Inspector** per the shared aside card: for a nav entry, eyebrow "Nav item · Page", the label, the nav id; Label, Icon (a 32 px preview tile plus the icon name in mono), Type, the kind's target field (Page / Object / Dashboard / Report / URL + Open in / Action / Component / Doc page + Book), the object-only Landing (List view / Record), View, Record ID, Open mode and URL filters rows the inspector already has, "Visible when" showing the `visible` predicate read-only, and "Remove nav item" at the bottom. For a selected block or widget, that item's properties.

Everything the nav inspector enforces today stays: unbound entries are left out of the saved navigation (`navPlaceholderSave-11776`), entry identity by id (`navEntryIdentity-11774`), label maps (`navItemInspectorLabelMaps-11148`), standard entries (`standardNavEntries-11201`), the badge and separator rows (`railSeparatorBadge-11791`), the nav kinds list (`navItemTypes-11790`), deep links (`navDeepLink-11153`), autosave flush on navigation (`navAutosaveFlush-11189`).

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`InterfacesPillar`, `NavTree`, `StudioNavItemInspector`, `NavTargetSelect`, `NavUrlFields`), `interfaceCreate.tsx` (entry from the kind picker), `studio-canvas-preview.tsx` (page / object canvas frames), `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (kind names and descriptions; `engine.inspector.appNav.*` keys stay).

## Acceptance

1. With HotCRM open the rail renders the same order, groups and icons as the running app's sidebar for that package (screenshot pair), with kind tags; the empty Service group shows the empty row.
2. The "+" picker lists all ten kinds; choosing Separator adds a rule, choosing Group adds a header, choosing Link adds an unbound entry whose inspector shows URL and Open in.
3. Selecting Home (dashboard), Sales Home (page) and Leads (object) shows the three canvases described above with the item header's kind chip and api chip.
4. The band and the `w-9` strip are gone; the properties toggle in the header opens and closes the aside.
5. All `StudioDesignSurface.nav*`, `interfaces*`, `InterfacesPillar.*`, `interfaceCreate.*` and `studio-canvas-preview` tests stay green or are updated in the same PR, each ablated once.
6. Before/after screenshots at 1280 px, light and dark.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only; no inline style.
- Existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys stay.
- Gates: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `lint`, `build`, `pnpm check:i18n`.
- Lands after the shared rail and inspector cards (the Blocked-by lines below).
